name: Zigbee to MQTT bridge
description: Zigbee to MQTT bridge, get rid of your proprietary Zigbee bridges

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
# Service definitions for the big-bear-zigbee2mqtt application
services:
  # Service name: big-bear-zigbee2mqtt
  # The `big-bear-zigbee2mqtt` service definition
  big-bear-zigbee2mqtt:
    # Name of the container
    container_name: big-bear-zigbee2mqtt
    # Image to be used for the container
    image: koenkk/zigbee2mqtt:2.14.2@sha256:addbfb08fcef2e4477de1535636118241e10d13e898fbe4d9faba8a4d7396311
    # Container restart policy
    restart: unless-stopped
    # Volumes to be mounted to the container
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/data:/app/data
      - /run/udev:/run/udev:ro
    # Ports mapping between host and container
    ports:
      # Mapping port 8080 of the host to port 8080 of the container
      - "${APP_PORT}:8080"
    # Environment variables
    environment:
      - TZ=UTC
    devices:
      # Make sure this matched your adapter location
      - /dev/serial/by-id/usb-Texas_Instruments_TI_CC2531_USB_CDC___0X00124B0018ED3DDF-if00:/dev/ttyACM0
